$comment: The plugin library matrix. `repo` is the GitHub repo under TypeDreamMoon; sync-github.mjs fills in stars and the latest release. `source` credits an upstream project where this is a fork. Entries with `desc.zh` marked TODO have no README yet — replace with real copy before launch.

items.zh: 对准撞击点按 Fracture 再 Bake，得到 Sequencer 里可拖动的 Chaos Cache 轨。木质 Dataflow 预设，视口内实时力预览。
items.en: Aim a rig's arrow at the impact, press Fracture then Bake, and get a scrubbable Chaos Cache track in Sequencer. Wood-style Dataflow preset, live viewport force preview.

items.zh: 虚幻引擎工具箱，日常编辑器杂活的集合。
items.en: An Unreal Engine toolbox for everyday editor chores.

items.zh: 给 Windows 下的 UE 编辑器窗口套上 Win11 原生圆角，并修补 Slate 的 SWindow 样式使边框一致。
items.en: Applies Windows 11 rounded-corner preferences to the Unreal Editor's windows and patches Slate's SWindow styling to match.

items.zh: 编辑器主题预设，按 Dark / Gray / Light 分组，五个色系：Miku · Violet · Azure · Sakura · Ember。
items.en: Unreal Editor theme presets grouped by Dark / Gray / Light, in five families: Miku · Violet · Azure · Sakura · Ember.

items.zh: ImGui 的 AngelScript 绑定，运行时热更写调试界面。需要支持 AngelScript 的引擎。
items.en: AngelScript bindings for ImGui — write debug UI at runtime with hot reload. Needs an AngelScript-capable engine.

items.zh: Sequencer 字幕轨，运行时、PIE 与编辑器预览都通过 UMG 控件渲染当前字幕。
items.en: Subtitle tracks for Sequencer, rendered through UMG widgets at runtime, in PIE and in editor preview.

items.zh: 基于 Morph Target 的口型同步，同一份 DataAsset 同时服务 Sequencer 与运行时组件。
items.en: Morph-target lip sync. One DataAsset serves both Sequencer playback and the runtime component.

items.zh: Sequencer 的 Morph Target 轨道支持。
items.en: Morph Target track support for Sequencer.

items.zh: 节点式流程图核心：运行时执行器、图编辑器、流程作用域变量、蓝图/C++ 扩展与网络复制。
items.en: The core flow-graph plugin: a reusable runtime executor, a node editor, flow-scoped variables, Blueprint/C++ extensibility and replication.

items.zh: DreamFlow 的领域扩展：任务、对话、剧情与遭遇战流程族。
items.en: Domain extensions for DreamFlow: quest, dialogue, story and encounter flow families.
A Gameplay Task system for Unreal Engine 5.x.

items.zh: UMG / Slate 扩展：动态文本动画、2D UMG 里的伪 3D 曲面变换、蓝图动态组装的 Slate UI 树。
items.en: UMG / Slate extensions: dynamic text animation, pseudo-3D curved transforms inside 2D UMG, and Slate UI trees assembled from Blueprint.

items.zh: 世界空间 3D UI 系统，prefab 工作流，设计器手感对齐 UMG。UE 5.8。
items.en: A world-space 3D UI system with a prefab workflow and a designer built to feel like UMG's. UE 5.8.

items.zh: 音乐播放器插件，仓库里星标最高的运行时插件。
items.en: A music player plugin — the most-starred runtime plugin in the collection.

items.zh: Windows 系统媒体传输控件（SMTC）支持，让游戏内播放的音乐出现在系统媒体面板里。
items.en: Windows System Media Transport Controls support, so in-game music shows up in the OS media panel.

items.zh: C++20 写的高性能歌词解析库，支持 lrc / ass 等格式。
items.en: A high-performance lyrics parser in C++20, covering lrc / ass and more.
